pages.title: Obsidian Singularity
pages.text: Obsidian compacted into one point. It is black volcanic glass, already hard to break, now impossible. Its surface reflects things that are not there, and it is faintly warm, as if still cooling from the lava.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Obsidian is lava cooled too fast to crystallise. I fed the Singularity Compactor a quarry's worth of it, and the glass collapsed into a single dark point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
